title: Microsoft Faces Japan Antitrust Probe As Gaming Shifts And AI Deals Grow
title_zh: 随着游戏业的转变和人工智能交易的增长，微软面临日本反垄断调查
summary: Japan's Fair Trade Commission raided Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) offices in Tokyo over suspected monopoly abuse related to its software and cloud practices.
summary_zh: 日本公平贸易委员会突击搜查了微软（NasdaqGS：MSFT）位于东京的办事处，原因是其软件和云业务涉嫌滥用垄断。

title: JPMorgan’s EA Buyout Role Tests Growth Plans In Branches And AI
title_zh: 摩根大通的 EA 收购角色测试分支机构和人工智能的增长计划
summary: JPMorgan Chase is leading the debt financing for a record-setting $55b leveraged buyout of Electronic Arts. The bank is ramping up a new U.S. branch expansion focused on underserved areas.
summary_zh: 摩根大通 (JPMorgan Chase) 正在牵头为艺电 (Electronic Arts) 创纪录的 550 亿美元杠杆收购债务融资。该银行正在加大美国新分行的扩张力度，重点关注服务欠缺的地区。

title: F1 season kicks into high gear with new Apple TV streaming deal
title_zh: F1 赛季通过新的 Apple TV 流媒体协议进入高潮
summary: The Formula One is changing lanes in March with Apple TV (AAPL) becoming the exclusive streamer for the international racing league.
summary_zh: 随着 Apple TV (AAPL) 成为国际赛车联盟的独家流媒体，一级方程式赛车将于 3 月改变车道。

title: JPMorgan Prepares $14.5 Billion Debt Sale for $55 Billion EA Buyout
title_zh: 摩根大通准备出售 145 亿美元债务以收购 EA 550 亿美元
summary: Wall Street banks plan US and European offerings as investors show early interest in financing tied to Electronic Arts acquisition.
summary_zh: 由于投资者对与艺电收购相关的融资表现出早期兴趣，华尔街银行计划在美国和欧洲发行股票。

title: Apple’s New Budget Devices And F1 Deal Test Ecosystem Stickiness
title_zh: 苹果的新预算设备和 F1 交易测试生态系统粘性
summary: Apple launched the budget-focused MacBook Neo and entry-level iPhone 17e, both powered by the latest Apple silicon and targeted at price-sensitive buyers.
summary_zh: 苹果推出了注重预算的 MacBook Neo 和入门级 iPhone 17e，两款产品均采用最新的苹果芯片，面向对价格敏感的买家。
